content.comment_body: Hello, I created a program in [product_name] V8.3 and want to transfer it to a PLC with article number [article_no]. However, I receive an error when attempting to send the program. Could there be an issue with the addresses or the connection? I have attached a photo illustrating the problem.
Attached is a photo showing the connection setup.

The PLC with article number [article_no] corresponds to the current [product_name] [version_no]. For this model, you need [product_name] V8.4; V8.3 cannot communicate with it. You can download the upgrade for [product_name] V8.4 following these installation instructions: [document]

analysis.insight_summary: The user ran into an error while transferring a program from [product_name] V8.3 to a PLC identified by [article_no]. The issue was due to software version incompatibility: the PLC is [product_name] [version_no] which requires [product_name] V8.4 or later. Advice from the community clarified that a software upgrade was necessary for successful communication.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated uploading a program from [product_name] to the PLC seamlessly, without encountering compatibility or connection problems.
